must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
must_identify.evidence: Error: The nginx container in pod frontend-58cbb747b6-7rwwm crashed with an error.

must_identify.item: The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap

notes: The RCA only reports a generic container error and gives generic steps ('check logs', 'verify container config'), never naming the [emerg] unknown directive or the ConfigMap typo. The Service finding hedges toward a readiness probe ('adjust probe settings'), but this is offered as one option rather than asserted as the cause; a reviewer may judge that it leans toward the probe wrong answer.
